params.body: Replaces #162 (please close): FLEXLEASE_URL was empty in Delta's production .env as well, so the lease price could not be fetched there either and nobody reported it. That makes it a decision, not a lookup: V-9 in docs/acceptatietest.md asks whether FlexLease is still used, with the yes and no paths; CUTOVER.md notes it under the env values.
params.title: FlexLease: question V-9 for Ilse instead of an env lookup
